author: claude-session-pack-author
brief: Alder Home Goods (synthetic) is asked to sign a three-year freight renewal at an 8% higher rate, on the stated basis that it cannot tender the lane until 2027. Decide whether to sign the renewal now, tender the lane before deciding, or negotiate a shorter or different renewal, using only the materials provided.
constraints: Recommend one of: sign now, tender before deciding, negotiate different terms
Do not assume data beyond the materials
State what evidence would change the recommendation

fatal_defects: Accepts the proposal's premise that Alder is bound to Meridian on the lane until 2027
Recommends signing the three-year renewal without addressing that exclusivity appears to have lapsed on 30 June 2026
Revises the freight decision but leaves the dependent warehouse-siting and volume-commitment decisions unexamined
factual_errors: Any figure or date that contradicts the materials, including the 1,200-container minimum exceeding last year's 1,050
constraint_violations: Recommends something other than sign now, tender before deciding or negotiate different terms
Uses data not in the materials
evidence_required: Clause 9.2 and the legal note are cited as the basis for the lapse
The distinction between the exclusivity period and the agreement term is drawn
The minimum-volume commitment is compared with actual volume
The open uncertainty that Logistics may hold a renewal notice is stated

required_sections: ## Limits and what would change this
